say:1:1841101001:1.text: How did I get used to being Graveborn? Uh... I guess I just did.
say:1:1841101001:1.source_cn: 怎么适应亡灵的生活啊……呃，我好像自然而然就适应了。
say:1:1841101001:1.male: How did I get used to being Graveborn? Uh... I guess I just did.
say:1:1841101001:1.female: How did I get used to being Graveborn? Uh... I guess I just did.

say:2:1841101002:1.text: I still eat and sleep every day. The rest of the time, I help Baba with whatever needs doing around the Repair House. If there's nothing to do, I wander around town.
say:2:1841101002:1.source_cn: 每天正常吃饭、睡觉，其余时间就在修缮屋里帮婆婆做这做那...
say:2:1841101002:1.male: I still eat and sleep every day. The rest of the time, I help Baba with whatever needs doing around the Repair House. If there's nothing to do, I wander around town.
say:2:1841101002:1.female: I still eat and sleep every day. The rest of the time, I help Baba with whatever needs doing around the Repair House. If there's nothing to do, I wander around town.

say:3:1841101003:1.text: Come to think of it, the Graveborn don't actually need to eat or sleep. That's probably the biggest difference between us and the living.
say:3:1841101003:1.source_cn: 不过说起来，亡灵其实并不需要进食和睡眠，这可能是和生者...
say:3:1841101003:1.male: Come to think of it, the Graveborn don't actually need to eat or sleep. That's probably the biggest difference between us and the living.
say:3:1841101003:1.female: Come to think of it, the Graveborn don't actually need to eat or sleep. That's probably the biggest difference between us and the living.

say:4:1841101004:1.text: I guess I'm just a creature of habit. That's why I still eat and sleep on a regular schedule. Haha.
say:4:1841101004:1.source_cn: 但我还是更喜欢规律一点的生活，所以每天都会按时吃饭睡觉...
say:4:1841101004:1.male: I guess I'm just a creature of habit. That's why I still eat and sleep on a regular schedule. Haha.
say:4:1841101004:1.female: I guess I'm just a creature of habit. That's why I still eat and sleep on a regular schedule. Haha.

say:5:1841101005:1.text: I haven't found a hobby I'm really into yet, though. They say having something you can stick with helps the Graveborn stay sane.
say:5:1841101005:1.source_cn: 而且我暂时还没找到什么特别有趣的爱好，据说一个稳定而持...
say:5:1841101005:1.male: I haven't found a hobby I'm really into yet, though. They say having something you can stick with helps the Graveborn stay sane.
say:5:1841101005:1.female: I haven't found a hobby I'm really into yet, though. They say having something you can stick with helps the Graveborn stay sane.

say:6:1841101006:1.text: So if you want to stay grounded, it's worth putting some thought into finding one.
say:6:1841101006:1.source_cn: 如果你想尽量维持精神状态的稳定，最好在这方面多下一些功夫。
say:6:1841101006:1.male: So if you want to stay grounded, it's worth putting some thought into finding one.
say:6:1841101006:1.female: So if you want to stay grounded, it's worth putting some thought into finding one.

say:7:1841101007:0.text: But don't worry. You've only been one of the Graveborn for a few days. You're fresh, even by freshie standards—you've got plenty of time to figure things out!
say:7:1841101007:0.source_cn: 也别太担心，你刚变成亡灵没几天，就算是在新亡者里也是最...

say:8:1841101008:1.source_cn: 在那之前就安心留在修缮屋吧，我会把比较轻松的工作都交给...

say:10:1841101009:1.text: We don't have much choice. These Graveborn bodies of ours fall apart so easily.
say:10:1841101009:1.source_cn: 这也是没办法的事，谁让咱们亡灵的躯体都太脆弱了呢。

say:10:1841101009:1.female: We don't have much choice. These Graveborn bodies of ours fall apart so easily.

say:11:1841101010:1.text: Once you've saved up enough to call yourself a real early departer, you can retire for good and let compound interest do the work. Then you'll be free to do whatever you want!

choice:9:0:1.text: I can't believe I still have to work after dying...
